title: Mini Mood Sound Studio
oneLiner: A playful ambient-focus app that mixes desk scenes and layered sounds into a shareable mood setup.
targetUser: Remote workers, students, and cozy desk-setup fans who want a quick focus ritual.
keyUX: Choose a mood, blend a few sound layers, and preview a charming desk scene in under a minute.
stitchPrompt: Design a playful desktop ambient-focus app called Mini Mood Sound Studio for remote workers and students who enjoy aesthetic desk setups. It should let people quickly combine a visual desk scene with layered ambient sounds, save the result as a named mood, and share a charming snapshot of the setup. Include a mood-scene hero, a sound-layer mixer, a room object picker bar, a session preview canvas, a saved-scene carousel, and a share action panel. Design direction: use a playful experimental aesthetic with lavender mist, butter cream, sky cyan, and candy coral accents; keep the product expressive, collectible, and visually rich while preserving clear controls and delightful motion cues.
